bio.text: John Hauer is the Libertarian candidate for Kansas's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, nominated at the Libertarian Party of Kansas state convention in April.
He is based in Topeka, is a veteran who was deployed to Iraq twice, and works as a delivery driver and at a warehouse.
He has not held elected office, though he has held positions in Libertarian organizations.

sources.title: Who's running for Congress in Kansas' 2nd District? Here's a guide to the candidates
